# 📚 Data Dictionary

This document defines the key metrics and tables used in the E-Commerce Profitability Audit.

## Key Metrics
* **`total_net_revenue`**: Gross revenue minus total discounts given.
* **`avg_profit_margin_pct`**: `(total_profit / total_net_revenue) * 100`. Measures the efficiency of revenue generation.
* **`avg_customer_lifetime_value`**: Average total revenue generated by a single customer over their entire relationship with the company.
* **`return_rate_pct`**: `(total_returns / total_orders) * 100`. A critical operational KPI indicating customer dissatisfaction or logistical failure.

## Dimensional Attributes
* **`discount_tier`**: Categorical grouping of orders: "0% (No Discount)", "1-10% (Light)", "11-20% (Moderate)", ">20% (Heavy)".
* **`delivery_performance`**: Categorical: "On Time" or "Late".
* **`acquisition_channel`**: The marketing source of the customer (e.g., Organic Search, YouTube, Direct, Email Marketing).
